# the screen: the container packets and the offers with the experience, level and the progress bar

MS 32 minecraft:paper*64
MS 33 minecraft:book*3
MS 34 minecraft:stone*70

PKT A minecraft:container_set_content 1201012700000005a40800001ef50700000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000028f507000040f908000040f908000003fa080000460100000000000000
